messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — Payments API errors increasing for Emerald Financial (eu-west-1). Paging on-call @maya_oncall. Error rate ~18% for /v1/payments/authorize, error=503. Inc link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-6001

maya_oncall: Taking this. Acknowledged. Spinning up diagnostic checks now.

sam_ops: I see repeated OOMs on payments-gateway-3 pod (node g4dn-12). Rolling restart attempt started, scaling replica count +2. Will post logs in a sec. :hammer_and_wrench:

jordan_se: Account impacted: Emerald Financial (EMERALD-92). Primary contacts: lisa@emerald.com, peter@emerald.com, amanda@emerald.com. CSM lead: @lisa_csm. Routing: CSM to send customer notice, SE to follow up with technical context.

lisa_csm: Draft notify for Emerald Financial (short):

"Hi Lisa/Peter — we’re investigating intermittent payment failures affecting some EU transactions. Our on-call team is working on a mitigation; retries may succeed. We’ll share an ETA within 30 minutes and send a post-incident summary. If you need immediate assistance, reply here or call +1-555-0100"

noah_eng: Mitigation suggestion: flip traffic to payments-fallback cluster (same region) and enable request-level retries. Command to enable canary reroute:```bash
kubectl patch svc payments-gateway -n prod -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"canary":"enabled"}}}'
```
Follow-up: check payment-queue length and downstream auth service latency (auth-svc).

maya_oncall: Good. Initiating fallback now. Status page update (short):

"Partial outage: Payments API — Some customers in eu-west-1 may experience failed payment authorizations. We are investigating and have applied a traffic fallback. Next update in 30 minutes or when we have an ETA"

sam_ops: Pagerduty incident created: INC-6001. Added initial timeline + logs. I'll attach pod logs and kube events to the incident ticket.

jordan_se: Tailored impact blurb for Emerald:

"Impact: A subset of payment attempts originating from EU customers may fail with a temporary 503. Scope: Approximately 2–5% of transactions for Emerald Financial at peak. Customer-facing mitigation: automatic retries may succeed; if not, please retry after 2 minutes. We are not seeing charge duplication risk at this time"

noah_eng: Heads-up: I'll take primary during mitigation. @maya_oncall please handoff to me in 20m if still open. Action items: 1) monitor errors (slo-dashboard) 2) validate fallback success 3) roll back if fallback increases latency.

maya_oncall: Acknowledged. Logging handoff: taking notes in INC-6001. Will post a short summary for the after-action and customer postmortem once resolved. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Next automated update scheduled in 30m.
